comments.author: @korbel.design
comments.text: The hot dog is ridiculously cheap... I wonder how they might be able to make any money on it. Perhaps high sales volume but it's too cheap. The duck, oh yeah! And the pork with potato dumplings... one of the best ever too! Wow, you've found the best Czech food.

comments.author: @CZpersi
comments.text: I would agree with everything, except that chimney cake. That's a tourist trap, and Czechs don't eat that. Any regular Ice Cream is more typical. If you want to try a very typical Czech ice cream, go to any supermarket and ask for "Míša" (pronounced "Meeshah"). It is delicious and very cheap.

comments.author: @BenRangel
comments.text:
I'm surprised those hotdogs are seen as a really special Prague thing.
They look like what every hot dog stand and gas station in Sweden has, we call em "french hotdog". It's true though that they are delicious - some days I get a craving. Nothing better when you need a quick snack after a night out in autumn.
